svg.aria-label: Weights connect adjacent neural network layers Input $x_1$ — Scale by $w_{11}$ → Hidden $h_1$ Input $x_1$ — Scale by $w_{12}$ → Hidden $h_2$ Input $x_2$ — Scale by $w_{21}$ → Hidden $h_1$ Input $x_2$ — Scale by $w_{22}$ → Hidden $h_2$ Hidden $h_1$ — Scale by $v_1$ → Output $y$ Hidden $h_2$ — Scale by $v_2$ → Output $y$ Each hidden unit sums its weighted inputs and applies an activation. The output combines the two hidden activations.
svg.title: Weights connect adjacent neural network layers

foreignObject.div: 1. Input x1​ → Hidden h1​: Scale by w11​
2. Input x1​ → Hidden h2​: Scale by w12​
3. Input x2​ → Hidden h1​: Scale by w21​
4. Input x2​ → Hidden h2​: Scale by w22​
5. Hidden h1​ → Output y: Scale by v1​
6. Hidden h2​ → Output y: Scale by v2​
